task_definition.task_name: Dataless SEED File Clone and Adapt

task_description.overview: Create a new Dataless SEED file for a station by cloning an existing one and updating station metadata, channel metadata, instrument response parameters, and sensitivity gains.
steps: Import ObsPy Parser and UTCDateTime modules.
Parse the existing Dataless SEED file from the given URL or path to retrieve blockettes.
Update blockette 50 with new network code, station call letters, site name, latitude, longitude, elevation, and effective dates.
Update blockette 33 abbreviation description for the new seismometer.
a. Update blockette 52 with channel identifier, location identifier, latitude, longitude, elevation, start and end dates.
b. Update blockette 53 with pole-zero parameters: number of complex poles/zeros, real and imaginary poles/zeros, and their errors; normalization factor and frequency.
c. Update blockette 58 with sensitivity gains for seismometer gain, digitizer gain, and overall sensitivity.
Write the modified blockettes to a new Dataless SEED file.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Load the Dataless SEED file at {existing_seed_path}. Parse its blockettes and update blockette 50 with new station metadata, blockette 33 with the {seismometer_abbreviation}, and blockettes 52, 53, and 58 for each channel (Z, N, E) with the provided pole-zero parameters and sensitivity gains. Finally, write the modified Dataless SEED volume to {seed_file}.
